scene1_screen1.text: The clouds part for just a moment, revealing the shadowed outline of what might be an ancient structure carved into the mountainside. They take a breathless pause, not just from the altitude, but the weight of what might lie ahead.

scene1_screen2.text: Carolina had followed Jack this far, against her better judgment. His lead — one cryptic line in a half-burned journal — had matched a passage in her father’s final notes. That echo had become a path.

scene1_screen3.text: Now, with Amaia — their quiet, sharp-eyed guide whose knowledge of the mountains seemed older than the stones themselves — they were deeper into the Andes than she’d ever dared to go. And the truth might finally be close enough to touch.

scene1_screen4.text: This is it. The same symbol from my father's last map.

scene1_screen5.text: Then we’re close. You’re sure it wasn’t just a coincidence? (grinning) Because treasure hunters love coincidences. Especially when they might lead to gold.

scene1_screen6.text: He wasn’t chasing gold. He was looking for something sacred… something forgotten.

scene1_screen7.text: The trail ends at a stone outcrop, half-swallowed by vines. A faint carving is barely visible. An eye within a spiral, just as described in the journal.

scene1_screen8.text: (softly) The Eye of Viracocha. Guardian of the hidden paths. They say it sees the hearts of those who pass… and closes to the unworthy.

scene1_screen9.text: Carolina reaches out, brushing the dust from the carving. The stone feels warm beneath her fingers. Suddenly, the clouds part, illuminating a hidden pathway beyond the ledge.

scene1_screen10.text: She hesitates. Her father’s words brought her here — but what if this is a mistake? The air feels heavier now. Even Jack falls quiet.

scene1_choice1_option1_screen1.text: (steps forward, voice trembling) This path isn’t on any of the maps… but my father mentioned it in the margins.

scene1_choice1_option1_screen2.text: (half-joking) Risky. I like it already. But, seriously. Are you sure you want to do this?

scene1_choice1_option1_screen3.text: (resolute) If I turn back now, I’ll never know. He left something behind, Jack. I have to find it.

scene1_choice1_option1_screen4.text: (nods solemnly) Then we walk with care. Once the mountain accepts you, it begins listening.

scene1_choice1_option1_screen5.text: (grinning) Guess we'd better watch what we say.

scene1_choice1_option1_screen6.text: A gust shifts the mist, momentarily revealing the trail ahead. Carolina’s fingers tighten around the strap of her pack. She glances once at Jack and Amaia, the unspoken decision hanging in the air.

scene1_choice1_option2_screen1.text: (turning to Amaia) This carving — what is it, really? My father called it the Eye of Viracocha, but he never explained what it meant.

scene1_choice1_option2_screen2.text: (touches the stone lightly, reverently) The Creator saw all, judged all. The spiral draws you inward… to yourself. Step forward without truth, and the path will turn on you.

scene1_choice1_option2_screen3.text: (raises an eyebrow) A test. Great. Any chance we get hints?

scene1_choice1_option2_screen4.text: (smirking) Only one: speak what you came for, or the mountain will decide you’re not worth the answer.

scene1_choice1_option2_screen5.text: The wind stirs the vines, parting them just enough to show a sliver of the path beyond. Jack leans forward to see better, while Amaia’s gaze lingers on Carolina — as if waiting for her to take the first step.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen1.text: Carolina pulls out her father’s leather-bound journal and flips carefully through its faded pages. The worn paper smells faintly of dust and rain, each note a fragment of his last journey.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen2.text: Wait… here. He wrote about this exact symbol.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen3.text: (leans in close) “Spiral eye between the peaks. Entry only with the truth in hand.” Sounds like something out of a prophecy.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen4.text: (frowning) He also wrote: “Beware the first step. The mountain remembers.”

scene1_choice1_option3_screen5.text: (softly) It’s not a metaphor. The ancestors believed the earth remembers pain and love.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen6.text: (grins, trying to lighten the mood) Hopefully, it remembers good looks and charm, too.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen8.text: A shaft of light slips through the clouds, catching the carving and revealing the faint outline of an opening. Carolina closes the journal slowly, her thumb still pressed against the page, eyes fixed on what lies ahead.

scene1_screen11.text: Without speaking, they file in single line, boots scraping against slick rock, until the world behind them disappears in the gray.

scene2_screen1.text: A narrow, hidden trail cuts along the mountainside. The air is colder here. Mist clings to their boots and curls around ancient stone fragments poking out from the earth like ribs. Far below, the river roars like distant thunder.

scene2_screen2.text: The moment their soles touch the first weathered stones, something shifts. This place feels… deliberate. Not just old, but older than the mountain itself, as if it were carved to test whoever dared to step here.

scene2_screen3.text: The jungle fades into silence behind them. Ahead, the cliff bends toward a shadowed break — a natural tunnel yawning open in the rock face.

scene2_screen4.text: My father walked this path. I can feel it.

scene2_screen5.text: Or fell off it. (grins) Seriously, though, how has no one else found this?

scene2_screen6.text: Because most are too loud to hear. The city doesn’t want to be found. You didn’t find it — it let you in.

scene2_screen7.text: (whispers, more to herself) Then why did it let my father in… and not back out?

scene2_screen8.text: The trail ends at a sheer rock wall — but a crack runs through it, just wide enough to slip inside. They squeeze through, the cold stone pressing against their shoulders.

scene2_screen9.text: Inside, the air changes — damp, still, and smelling faintly of moss. The walls are smooth black rock, sloping downward. Symbols appear in the torchlight: faint at first, then bolder, glowing softly with living lichen.

scene2_screen10.text: Jack stays close behind Carolina, his hand brushing her backpack strap. Amaia lights a hand-carved torch, the flame bending in the faint draft. Shadows leap across the carvings — animals, constellations, and unblinking eyes.

opts.text: Press onward quickly, relying on intuition
Insist that Carolina decode the symbols

scene2_choice1_option1_screen1.text: (examining the symbols) These carvings... they’re a map, but also a warning. Looks like this place tests those who enter. (pauses) We go slow. Test every step.

scene2_choice1_option1_screen2.text: (nodding) Agreed. If my father deciphered this, he must have left clues deeper inside.

scene2_choice1_option1_screen3.text: (quietly) The mountain speaks in riddles. And it remembers the ones who don’t listen.

scene2_choice1_option1_screen4.text: They move with deliberate care, tracing the lines and matching them to the journal’s sketches. The carvings seem to shift under the torchlight, like the story is changing with each step.

scene2_choice1_option2_screen1.text: (grinning) Forget the wall for now. Sometimes, thinking too much gets you killed. We move fast, before the mountain changes its mind.

scene2_choice1_option2_screen2.text: (hesitant) I’m not sure rushing is wise... but... Maybe you’re right. We don’t know what dangers lurk.

scene2_choice1_option2_screen3.text: (concerned) The mountain waits for no one. But it always waits for the careless.

scene2_choice1_option2_screen4.text: They push forward at a pace that makes their hearts race. The carvings blur past, their warnings unread, swallowed by the dark behind them.

scene2_choice1_option3_screen1.text: (curious) Carolina, you’re the expert here. What do these symbols say?

scene2_choice1_option3_screen2.text: (studying the wall) They’re ancient warnings mixed with a story of Viracocha’s guardians. If I’m right, we’re being tested on our intent...

scene2_choice1_option3_screen3.text: (smiling softly) The right words can open doors or close them forever.

scene2_choice1_option3_screen4.text: They slow to a halt, the torchlight pooling over Carolina’s hands as she traces each symbol. The tunnel seems to hold its breath as her voice whispers the translations into the stillness.

scene2_screen11.text: The passage narrows, forcing them into single file. Droplets fall from unseen heights, each one echoing like a distant heartbeat.

scene2_screen12.text: The torchlight catches a curve in the tunnel ahead — and beyond it, a faint golden glow pulses like something alive deep inside the mountain, growing brighter with each step until the tunnel exhales them into a cavern.

scene3_screen1.text: The cavern opens wide around them, swallowing sound. Murals coil along the walls in spirals — oceans birthing mountains, skies split by lightning, humankind rising under the gaze of faceless guardians.

scene3_screen2.text: The golden light they followed spills from a squat stone pedestal at the center of the chamber. The spiral eye carved into its surface glows faintly, the light pulsing as if in time with something unseen.

scene3_screen3.text: Amaia’s torch paints the walls in warm flickers, making pigments shimmer — waves curl, stars blink, and guardians seem to turn their heads as they pass.

scene3_screen4.text: (whispering) This is what my father was searching for. Not treasure, but truth. And maybe... a way to bring peace to what was lost.

scene3_screen5.text: (eyes scanning the room) If this is what he found, then he must have been close. Too close for comfort, maybe.

scene3_screen6.text: (somber) The mountain doesn’t just give up its secrets. It demands sacrifice... and understanding.

scene3_screen7.text: All eyes fall on the glowing spiral eye. It waits — patient, unblinking — for a decision.

scene3_choice1.text: How do you respond to this revelation?

opts.text: Place your hand on the pedestal and try to unlock its secret
Take a moment to reflect and analyze the murals first
Voice doubts and question the risk of moving forward

scene3_choice1_option1_screen1.text: (steady breath) If the mountain wants us to prove ourselves, then I’ll answer. It’s time to face what my father couldn’t.

scene3_choice1_option1_screen2.text: (watching closely) I’m with you. No matter what comes next.

scene3_choice1_option1_screen3.text: (softly) May your heart be as strong as your mind.

scene3_choice1_option1_screen4.text: Carolina steps forward, the hum deepening with each stride. She presses her palm to the cold stone, steady and unflinching. Light coils up from the spiral, wrapping her hand in a faint glow as the air tightens around them.

scene3_choice1_option2_screen1.text: (thoughtful) We need to understand everything before acting. The murals might hold the key to not just opening this door, but surviving what’s behind it.

scene3_choice1_option2_screen2.text: (impatiently) Careful thinking’s your thing, I get it. But sometimes, you gotta act before you overthink.

scene3_choice1_option2_screen3.text: Balance is key — action with understanding. Don’t rush the mountain’s lesson.

scene3_choice1_option2_screen4.text: Carolina circles the pedestal, torchlight sliding over the walls. The scenes seem to shift as she moves — waves recede to reveal footprints, a guardian raises its arm to point toward the center.

scene3_choice1_option2_screen5.text: She stops at the final panel, tracing a hidden figure etched into the stone. Then, with a slow breath, she turns, hand hovering before finally settling onto the spiral eye. A faint light stirs beneath her touch.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen1.text: (hesitantly) What if my father didn’t return because he was unprepared? What if we’re walking into something we can’t control?

scene3_choice1_option3_screen2.text: Fear is natural. But courage isn’t the absence of fear—it’s moving forward despite it.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen3.text: I’ve faced danger before, this… We can do this. Together.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen4.text: The chamber seems to lean in, listening. The pedestal’s glow pulses once, like a heartbeat, as if testing their resolve.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen5.text: Carolina exhales, her doubts still heavy, and steps closer. Fingers trembling, she rests her palm on the spiral eye. The stone feels alive beneath her touch.

scene3_screen8.text: Golden threads burst outward, spilling across the murals until the entire chamber glows.

scene3_screen9.text: A deep, resonant hum fills the air, vibrating through their bones. Dust sifts down from the vaulted stone, glimmering in the glow like falling embers. The hum swells until it’s almost a heartbeat — vast, patient, and not their own.

scene3_screen10.text: Stone grinds against stone. In the far wall, a hidden doorway unfurls like the petals of some ancient stone flower, revealing a spiral stairwell plunging into shadow.

scene3_screen12.text: (firmly) We go together. No matter what.

scene3_screen13.text: The path forward is both a journey through the past and a choice for the future.

scene3_screen14.text: They step onto the stairwell. The golden light clings to their backs for a moment before the darkness swallows it whole. With each turn of the spiral, the stone presses closer, the air grows heavier, and the faint scent of earth becomes rich and ancient.

scene4_screen1.text: The golden glow fades above them as they descend in silence, the spiral stairwell curling deep into the mountain’s heart. The steady rhythm of their steps folds into the deeper pulse that resonates through the stone.

scene4_screen2.text: The walls close in and open again with each curve, revealing carvings that seem older than memory itself — spirals, constellations, shapes like rivers splitting and rejoining.

scene4_screen3.text: Some are bright with moss-glow, breathing faint light into the shadows. Others are defaced, their lines violently scratched away as if someone tried to erase the truth they carried.

scene4_screen4.text: The pulse is stronger here, no longer just heard but felt in their bones — patient, unyielding.

scene4_screen5.text: (quietly, almost reverently) These glyphs… they’re older than any known dialect. This isn’t just pre-Incan… it might be proto-Andean. No wonder my father was obsessed with this.

scene4_screen6.text: (smirking) You’re telling me we just stepped into a language that history forgot?

scene4_screen7.text: (speaking low, with certainty) These words were never meant for outsiders. But you’re not intruding — you’re answering a call. Keep listening.

scene4_screen8.text: At last, the stairwell levels out into a wide antechamber. The walls are lined with massive stone panels — each depicting scenes of creation, destruction, and rebirth. At the far end stands a massive circular doorway sealed with a three-lock mechanism, its surface etched with a spiral sun and constellations.

scene4_screen9.text: Carolina steps forward, and her torchlight catches on a small inscription just beneath the largest mural. Her eyes widen.

scene4_choice1.text: What do you do with this inscription?

opts.text: Read it aloud, translating as you go
Hesitate, there´s something more to this

scene4_choice1_option1_screen1.text: (steady) “To enter, you must carry what you’ve lost… and offer what cannot be kept.”

scene4_choice1_option1_screen3.text: My father wrote something like this. He thought it referred to… grief.

scene4_choice1_option1_screen4.text: (half-joking) Well, I’ve lost money, time, and a couple of toes to frostbite. Does that count?

scene4_choice1_option1_screen5.text: This isn’t a joke, Jack. It’s a vow. The mountain doesn't want adventurers. It wants pilgrims.

scene4_choice1_option1_screen6.text: Read it with your whole self, not just your voice. The ancestors won’t answer half-hearted calls.

scene4_choice1_option1_screen7.text: Carolina continues, translating with clarity and reverence.

scene4_choice1_option1_screen8.text: As her voice rises at the final word, the symbols around the arch shimmer and spin. One ring on the stone door clicks loose, rotating into a new position.

scene4_choice1_option1_screen9.text: (low whistle) I take it that’s a good sign?

scene4_choice1_option2_screen1.text: (pulling out her camera) This writing is layered, with multiple dialects. Look at this verb form — it’s meant to shift depending on who’s reading it. I can’t risk misinterpreting it on the fly.

scene4_choice1_option2_screen2.text: (rolling his eyes) You realize we’re standing in a place no one's seen in centuries, right?

scene4_choice1_option2_screen3.text: (focused) Exactly. That’s why I won’t ruin it by rushing. If this is a language test from an ancient civilization, a wrong translation could mean more than just embarrassment.

scene4_choice1_option2_screen4.text: (nodding) Good. You show the mountain you respect its voice. That’s how you earn its trust.

scene4_choice1_option2_screen5.text: Carolina takes some photos quickly but precisely, cross-referencing the inscriptions with her father’s journal. After several tense minutes, she touches a glyph gently.

scene4_choice1_option2_screen6.text: (whispering) It’s a metaphor for balance. Loss, peace, intention.

scene4_choice1_option2_screen8.text: One of the rings on the stone door shifts, glowing warmly, acknowledging understanding, not boldness.

scene4_choice1_option2_screen9.text: (raising a brow) You unlocked it… with homework?

scene4_choice1_option2_screen10.text: (smiling) My dad always said — translation is trust.

scene4_choice1_option3_screen1.text: (uneasy) Something’s not right. This riddle… It’s too obvious. My father said this place used traps disguised as truth.

scene4_choice1_option3_screen2.text: (glancing around) Do you think it’s booby-trapped? Like pressure plates or darts-from-the-wall kind of thing?

scene4_choice1_option3_screen3.text: (shaking her head) Worse. I think the wrong interpretation closes the path... forever.

scene4_choice1_option3_screen4.text: (stepping forward, voice low) Then don’t just look with your eyes. Feel with your memory. What does the mountain want from you?

scene4_choice1_option3_screen5.text: Carolina kneels again — but instead of reading the main inscription, she brushes her hand across a faded line beneath it. A softer, older carving hidden from plain view. It pulses faintly under her touch.

scene4_choice1_option3_screen6.text: (murmuring) It’s not about what we say — it’s about what we carry. He didn’t write this part in the journal. He... he hid it.

scene4_choice1_option3_screen7.text: Without a word, she presses her palm gently to the hidden glyph.

scene4_choice1_option3_screen8.text: One of the rings on the door glows, clicks, and slides into position.

scene4_choice1_option3_screen9.text: (staring in disbelief) Okay... that’s definitely not in your dad’s field guide.

scene4_screen10.text: A second, deeper rumble shakes the chamber. The floor beneath them vibrates, as if the mountain itself is acknowledging their presence. The second ring turns — slower than the first — locking into place with a sound like stone sighing after centuries of stillness.

scene4_screen11.text: Two of the three rings now gleam in the torchlight. The last remains dark, waiting.

scene4_screen12.text: The path is almost open. One more truth, and the mountain will speak.

scene5_screen1.text: They stand before the final lock. The two freed rings hum faintly, as if urging the last to join them. The air is tense — not hostile, but expectant, like the mountain is holding its breath.

scene5_screen2.text: (quietly) This one is different. It won’t open for a single voice or hand.

scene5_screen3.text: (looking between them) Then… it needs all of us.

scene5_screen4.text: (grinning faintly) Guess the mountain’s big on teamwork.

scene5_screen5.text: They step forward together, each placing a hand on the final ring — cold stone under warm skin. For a heartbeat, nothing happens. Then a pulse of golden light surges outward, weaving between their fingers, binding them in a brief, weightless warmth.

scene5_screen6.text: The third ring turns with a deep, resonant click. All three glow now, their grooves forming a complete, unbroken pattern. Stone grinds against stone as the massive door begins to open, dust spilling like ancient breath into the chamber.

scene5_screen7.text: Beyond it lies a space untouched by time — vast, circular, and alive with moss-light streaming from vines high above. Black stone columns rise like sentinels, and at the center, a polished obsidian platform hovers above a golden-lit chasm.

scene5_screen8.text: They step inside. The space is a sanctum — part temple, part tomb, part memory. The heartbeat sound that followed them fades. The air here is still. Listening.

scene5_screen9.text: (softly) My father must’ve made it this far… But if he did, why didn’t he come back?

scene5_screen10.text: (stepping beside her) Maybe he found what he was looking for. Maybe it wasn’t something he could bring home.

scene5_screen11.text: (glancing at him) Or maybe… he stayed because it was safer than facing the world above.

scene5_screen12.text: (quiet, reverent) The mountain shows you only what you’re ready to see. If he didn’t return, it wasn’t punishment — it was choice.

scene5_screen13.text: They cross the chamber slowly. Each step feels heavy with memories. The platform pulses softly under your boots. At its center waits the final glyph — unlit, untouched. This one feels personal. Like it’s waiting for them.

scene5_screen14.text: Jack stops Carolina with a hand on her arm.

scene5_screen15.text: (voice lower) Hey... before you do this. I know I joke a lot. I act like this is all about maps and gold and glory. But it stopped being about that a long time ago.

scene5_screen17.text: (stepping closer) You. The way you see things, others miss. The way you don’t give up, even when it terrifies you. I didn’t come here to chase ghosts—but I think... I found something worth holding onto.

scene5_screen18.text: There’s a beat of silence. Just the dim glow of the mountain’s light against skin.

scene5_screen19.text: (quietly) I’ve spent so long chasing what I lost. I didn’t expect to find someone who made me want to stay.

scene5_screen20.text: He leans in slowly. There’s hesitation, tension — but when their lips meet, it’s not fire or thunder. It’s warmth. A quiet, anchoring truth in the middle of all this mystery.

scene5_screen23.text: (smiling) The mountain remembers love. It always has.

scene5_screen24.text: With a tremble that shakes their bones, the final lock clicks into place. The obsidian floor shifts, revealing a spiral staircase descending into golden mist. A low hum begins again — not a warning, but a welcome.

scene5_screen26.text: (firmly) Not rewrite it. Understand it. And maybe... finally, finish my father’s story.

scene5_choice1.text: With the path open, how will you move forward?

opts.text: Take the lead down the spiral staircase, determined to protect Carolina
Suggest Amaia lead the way so you and Carolina can walk together
Hesitate and suggest that they don't need to continue

scene5_choice1_option1_screen1.text: Jack stepped forward confidently, hand instinctively on the hilt of his machete.

scene5_choice1_option1_screen3.text: (raising an eyebrow, arms folded) Of course you are. Why am I not surprised?

scene5_choice1_option1_screen4.text: (glances back, serious now) Because if anything’s waiting down there, I’d rather it hit me first.

scene5_choice1_option1_screen5.text: (softening, stepping closer) I can take care of myself, Jack. I don’t need a hero.

scene5_choice1_option1_screen6.text: (smirking) Maybe not. But you’ve got one anyway.

scene5_choice1_option1_screen7.text: Truth is... I need to feel like I’m doing something. You’ve carried the weight of your father’s past this whole way. Just let me carry this.

scene5_choice1_option1_screen8.text: (watching quietly) Every path has a guardian. Maybe today, it’s you.

scene5_choice1_option1_screen9.text: Jack steps onto the first stone, torchlight flickering off the mist. His silhouette vanishes slowly into the spiral as Carolina follows a heartbeat behind, her eyes never leaving him.

scene5_choice1_option2_screen1.text: (turns toward Amaia, nodding) Hey, Amaia. You’ve guided us through this whole mountain. Think you can take point on this last stretch?

scene5_choice1_option2_screen2.text: (cocking her head with an amused smile) I could. But the path may ask more than directions.

scene5_choice1_option2_screen3.text: (grinning) Then it’s a good thing we’ve got you.

scene5_choice1_option2_screen4.text: (offering his hand to Carolina) I just… want to walk with you. Not behind you, not ahead. Beside you.

scene5_choice1_option2_screen5.text: (softly) You’re not trying to protect me?

scene5_choice1_option2_screen6.text: Not this time. I’m trying to stay close enough to remember why I started this. (pause) Back there… when we kissed… it wasn’t just heat-of-the-moment, Carolina. I meant it. All of it.

scene5_choice1_option2_screen7.text: (taking his hand) Then don’t let go. No matter what we find.

scene5_choice1_option2_screen8.text: With Amaia moving ahead like a shadow, Jack and Carolina follow side by side, hands clasped, steps synced as the spiral takes them deeper.

scene5_choice1_option3_screen1.text: (staring at the open path, voice quiet)…What if we don’t go?

scene5_choice1_option3_screen3.text: (avoiding her eyes, unsure) I mean… what if we’ve come far enough? You found the glyphs. We opened the doors. Maybe that’s enough. Maybe we’ve proven what needed to be proven.

scene5_choice1_option3_screen4.text: The mountain didn’t open itself for ‘almost.’ It’s waiting.

scene5_choice1_option3_screen5.text: (turns fully to Jack) Jack… is this fear talking?

scene5_choice1_option3_screen6.text: (voice low, honest) It’s not fear for me. It’s a fear for you. What if there’s something down there we can’t walk away from?

scene5_choice1_option3_screen7.text: (gently) Then we face it together. You said that, remember? This isn’t just my story anymore. It’s ours.

scene5_choice1_option3_screen8.text: (sighs, meeting her gaze) I just don’t want this place to take more than it’s already taken.

scene5_choice1_option3_screen9.text: (places a hand on his chest) Then don’t let it. Come with me. Not because we have to — but because we choose to.

scene5_choice1_option3_screen10.text: Jack swallows hard, nodding slowly. Whatever waits below, he won’t run from it. Not when her hand is still in his.

scene6_screen1.text: The spiral staircase releases them into open air — or what feels like it. A hidden valley spreads within the mountain’s heart, its rivers glowing as if lit from within. Ruins rise like the bones of a sleeping giant, carved with the same spirals and constellations as the glyphs above.

scene6_screen3.text: Guess your dad wasn’t chasing shadows after all.

scene6_screen4.text: This place isn’t lost. It’s waiting. And now… it knows your names.

scene6_screen5.text: They cross a stone bridge toward a central plaza. At its heart, an obsidian altar holds a single sealed vessel. Carolina hesitates, fingertips brushing the surface.

scene6_screen6.text: My father’s notes ended here. He wrote… “The last truth belongs to those who listen.”

scene6_screen7.text: Then maybe we open it together.

scene6_screen8.text: They lift the lid. Inside, instead of gold or jewels, rests a single folded cloth — a traveler’s sash, worn and sun-faded. Tucked inside: a journal.

scene6_screen10.text: She flips through pages filled with sketches of the city, stories of Amaia’s people, and one final line written for her: “I didn’t return because here, I was finally home. If you read this, Carolina, you’ve found where you belong — in the story you choose.”

scene6_screen12.text: Her voice trembles. Jack’s hand closes around hers. The mountain’s pulse is softer now, like a steady heartbeat at rest.

scene6_screen13.text: The path back will close when you leave. But the choice is yours — stay, or return to tell the world.

scene6_choice1.text: Now that you’ve found it, what will you do?

scene6_choice1_option1_screen1.text: Carolina sets the journal back onto the altar.

scene6_choice1_option1_screen2.text: I think… he was right. This place is more than ruins. It’s alive.

scene6_choice1_option1_screen3.text: And you want to be part of it.

scene6_choice1_option1_screen5.text: (smirks) Guess I’ve always been better at starting trouble than ending it. If we stay… we make this our home.

scene6_choice1_option1_screen6.text: Amaia steps closer, her eyes bright.

scene6_choice1_option1_screen7.text: The city accepts you. In time, you’ll understand its voice.

scene6_choice1_option1_screen8.text: The golden mist swirls higher, wrapping around them. Jack pulls Carolina closer as the air thickens with light. The last thing they see is the crystal ceiling reflecting their joined silhouettes before the mountain seals the path forever.

scene6_choice1_option2_screen1.text: Carolina tucks the journal into her pack.

scene6_choice1_option2_screen2.text: This was my father’s home… but my place is out there, telling his story.

scene6_choice1_option2_screen3.text: Then I’m walking with you. Always.

scene6_choice1_option2_screen5.text: The city will sleep again. But it will remember you.

scene6_choice1_option2_screen6.text: They step back to the bridge. The hum of the mountain follows them — not a warning, but a promise. At the staircase, Jack glances over his shoulder, taking in the last golden light before the stone seals shut.

scene6_choice1_option2_screen7.text: Let’s make sure the world knows this wasn’t a myth.

scene6_choice1_option2_screen8.text: (smiling faintly) And let’s keep some parts just for us.

scene6_choice1_option2_screen9.text: They climb toward daylight, carrying a truth only they can tell — and a bond that no distance will undo.

scene6_choice1_option3_screen1.text: Carolina remains by the altar, fingertips resting on her father’s final words.

scene6_choice1_option3_screen2.text: This is where I’m meant to be.

scene6_choice1_option3_screen4.text: I am. My whole life, I’ve been chasing something that would make me feel complete. I think… I just found it.

scene6_choice1_option3_screen5.text: (quietly) And I think I still belong out there.

scene6_choice1_option3_screen6.text: They stand in silence for a moment before he steps forward and kisses her — deep, lingering, memorizing.

scene6_choice1_option3_screen7.text: (softly) Then I’ll carry your story with me. Always.

scene6_choice1_option3_screen8.text: He walks toward the bridge without looking back. Carolina watches until the golden mist swallows him. The mountain closes the path with a sound like a sigh.

scene6_choice1_option3_screen9.text: Above, Jack emerges into the cold air of the world beyond. Below, Carolina steps deeper into the golden light, her shadow merging with the city’s endless glow.

scene6_screen14.text: You’ve reached the end of their journey — and perhaps the start of your own. How would you act if you discovered a secret city?
